June 11, 2019

GLB Standard Feature Highlights
Mercedes-Benz User Experience (MBUX) with new-generation Voice Control, including Natural Language Understanding and Keyword Activation (“Hey Mercedes”)
7” Digital Instrument Cluster & 7” Touchscreen Multimedia Display
LED headlamps
Smartphone Integration with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
8-Way Power Driver and Passenger Seats with 3-Position Memory
Rear Seats with 7-Stage Inclination and Forward/Backward Adjustment

Mercedes-Benz Emergency Call Service
GLB Optional Feature Highlights
3rd Row Seats
Premium Package including Blind Spot Assist, 10.25” media display with Touchscreen, 10.25” digital instrument cluster, KEYLESS-GO® Package and auto-dimming and power folding mirrors
Multimedia Package including MB Navigation, Augmented Reality for Navigation and Traffic Sign Assist
Parking Assistance Package with Surround View System and Active Parking Assist
Exterior Lighting Package with Active LED Headlamps and Adaptive Highbeam Assist
Driver Assistance Package
AMG Line
Night Package

GLB Technical Feature Highlights
Mercedes-Benz User Experience (MBUX): A completely revolutionary multimedia system featuring innovative technology based on Artificial Intelligence and an intuitive operating system. MBUX is pioneering a new level of in-car experience. The system can be operated by a new generation of Voice Control, the center touchscreen, a new Touchpad, and/or by the Touch Control Buttons on the steering wheel. The system has learning capabilities and intelligent Voice Control with Natural Language Understanding and a verbal cue of “Hey Mercedes.”
Touchscreen Multimedia Display: Central to the comprehensive MBUX concept is a touchscreen display
Off-Road Engineering Package: The Off-Road Engineering Package, which comes as standard on the GLB 250 4MATIC, encompasses an additional drive program (Off-Road) that adapts the engine's power delivery and the ABS control to better navigate off-road terrain away from paved roads. It can be activated via the DYNAMIC SELECT switch. The Off-Road Engineering Package also includes:
An animation of the driving situation can be viewed in the media display. The realistic presentation of gradient, inclination angle and technical settings help the driver to judge maneuvers correctly.
Hill-start assistance system Downhill Speed Regulation (DSR) automatically adheres to a preselected, slow speed between approx. 1 and 11 mph that is displayed in the instrument cluster and in the optional head-up display.
Optional 3 rd Row Seat:
Five-seater	Seven-seater (option)
Second seat row	Seat backrest can be divided and folded in a ratio of 40:20:40
Multi-stage seat backrest inclination adjustment
Seat row can be moved 6 inches longitudinally, sitting surface can be divided in a ratio of 40:60 (option)	Seat row can be moved 6 inches longitudinally, sitting surface can be divided in a ratio of 40:60
EASY-ENTRY function
Third seat row	-	Two retractable individual seats
Second Row Adjustability: The second row seats offer passengers the ability to adjust the inclination of the backrests in several stages while also providing the flexibility to adjust the seats forward increasing the cargo compartment by up to 6 cubic feet.
Driver Assistance Systems: The GLB receives the latest in driver assistance technology including intelligent hands-off detection. The Driver Assistance Package includes:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC ® is an adaptive cruise control system that is able to automatically adjust your set speed for traffic ahead
with Route-Based Speed Adaptation, the vehicle is able to reduce the speed in anticipatory mode by referencing map data ahead of curves, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads
Active Steering Assist generates steering torque which helps the driver to stay in the center of the lane on straight roads and slight bends, taking its guidance from vehicles ahead and lane markings
with Active Emergency Stop Assist , which brakes the vehicle to a stop in a controlled manner when the system recognizes that the driver is distracted for a longer period or cannot intervene in vehicle control
and Active Lane Change Assist , which assists the driver in a convenient and cooperative manner when making lane changes
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to help the driver avoid impending collisions with vehicles ahead, even stationary or crossing vehicles and pedestrians, if the driver fails to take action quickly enough
Active Speed Limit Assist automatically adapts the vehicle's speed to identified speed limits in conjunction with the embedded navigation
Active Blind Spot Assist is able to provide the driver with a visual alert, plus an audible alarm when a turn indicator is activated, to warn the driver if another vehicle is detected in the blind spot area. It can also help avoid a collision by single-sided braking if a lane change is still attempted with an obstacle in the blind spot
Active Lane Keeping Assist is able to warn the driver by means of vibrations of the steering wheel when the vehicle is unintentionally drifting out of its lane. If the vehicle passes over a solid line, or a dashed line when opposing traffic is detected, this system can pull the vehicle back into its lane by applying the brakes on one side
PRE-SAFE ® PLUS with PRE-SAFE ® Sound - activates the PRE-SAFE safety measures when a collision from behind is imminent as well as applying the brakes when the vehicle is at a standstill in order to prevent subsequent accidents. PRE-SAFE® Sound omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the “stapedius reflex,” which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident
Model Positioning
The Mercedes-Benz GLB is the newest addition to the Mercedes-Benz SUV lineup. A durable and practical SUV with compact dimensions, the GLB provides a generous amount of space for up to seven passengers with its available 3rd row – a first for a compact Mercedes-Benz. The all-new GLB is equipped with the latest safety technology, comfort, and user interface with the revolutionary MBUX (Mercedes-Benz User Experience).
At a Glance
GLB 250 SUV/GLB 250 4MATIC SUV

Off-Road Engineering Package: The Off-Road Engineering Package, which comes as standard on the GLB 250 4MATIC, encompasses an additional drive program (Off-Road) that adapts the engine's power delivery and the ABS control to better navigate off-road terrain away from paved roads. It can be activated via the DYNAMIC SELECT switch. The Off-Road Engineering Package also includes:
An animation of the driving situation can be viewed in the media display. The realistic presentation of gradient, inclination angle and technical settings help the driver to judge maneuvers correctly.
Hill-start assistance system Downhill Speed Regulation (DSR) automatically adheres to a preselected, slow speed between approx. 1 and 11 mph that is displayed in the instrument cluster and in the optional head-up display.
Optional 3rd Row Seat:
Five-seater	Seven-seater (option)
Second seat row	Seat backrest can be divided and folded in a ratio of 40:20:40 Multi-stage seat backrest inclination adjustment
Seat row can be moved 6 inches longitudinally, sitting surface can be divided in a ratio of 40:60 (option)	Seat row can be moved 6 inches longitudinally, sitting surface can be divided in a ratio of 40:60
EASY-ENTRY function
Third seat row	-	Two retractable individual seats
Second Row Adjustability: The second row seats offer passengers the ability to adjust the inclination of the backrests in several stages while also providing the flexibility to adjust the seats forward increasing the cargo compartment by up to 6 cubic feet.
Driver Assistance Systems: The GLB receives the latest in driver assistance technology including intelligent hands-off detection. The Driver Assistance Package includes:
Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC® is an adaptive cruise control system that is able to automatically adjust your set speed for traffic ahead
with Route-Based Speed Adaptation, the vehicle is able to reduce the speed in anticipatory mode by referencing map data ahead of curves, junctions, roundabouts, toll booths and exit roads
Active Steering Assist generates steering torque which helps the driver to stay in the center of the lane on straight roads and slight bends, taking its guidance from vehicles ahead and lane markings
with Active Emergency Stop Assist , which brakes the vehicle to a stop in a controlled manner when the system recognizes that the driver is distracted for a longer period or cannot intervene in vehicle control
and Active Lane Change Assist , which assists the driver in a convenient and cooperative manner when making lane changes
Active Brake Assist with Cross-Traffic Function is able to help the driver avoid impending collisions with vehicles ahead, even stationary or crossing vehicles and pedestrians, if the driver fails to take action quickly enough
Active Speed Limit Assist automatically adapts the vehicle's speed to identified speed limits in conjunction with the embedded navigation
Active Blind Spot Assist is able to provide the driver with a visual alert, plus an audible alarm when a turn indicator is activated, to warn the driver if another vehicle is detected in the blind spot area. It can also help avoid a collision by single-sided braking if a lane change is still attempted with an obstacle in the blind spot
Active Lane Keeping Assist is able to warn the driver by means of vibrations of the steering wheel when the vehicle is unintentionally drifting out of its lane. If the vehicle passes over a solid line, or a dashed line when opposing traffic is detected, this system can pull the vehicle back into its lane by applying the brakes on one side
PRE-SAFE® PLUS with PRE-SAFE® Sound - activates the PRE-SAFE safety measures when a collision from behind is imminent as well as applying the brakes when the vehicle is at a standstill in order to prevent subsequent accidents. PRE-SAFE® Sound omits a short interference signal if an imminent collision is detected, triggering a protective reflex in the human ear referred to as the “stapedius reflex,” which can help reduce hearing loss in the event of an accident
Model Positioning
The Mercedes-Benz GLB is the newest addition to the Mercedes-Benz SUV lineup. A durable and practical SUV with compact dimensions, the GLB provides a generous amount of space for up to seven passengers with its available 3rd row – a first for a compact Mercedes-Benz. The all-new GLB is equipped with the latest safety technology, comfort, and user interface with the revolutionary MBUX (Mercedes-Benz User Experience). With a striking design, exciting driving dynamics and space for up to seven occupants, the new Mercedes-AMG GLB 35 is an unrivalled entry in the compact SUV segment, providing unrivaled versatility and performance.
